Scene:
发现了夹竹桃有毒。别人看到他，很快给他吃一个灵芝。神农一吃就觉得比较好。然后，他继续写他发现的信息。会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 发现了夹竹桃有毒：it is unclear that夹竹桃refers to黄色的花
- 别人看到他：另外一个人，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃：也会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能吃，哪个植物不能吃

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 哪一个植物能不能吃：哪一种植物能吃，哪一种植物不能吃，use separate clauses to state which kinds are edible and which kinds are not; 哪一种 is the suitable measure-word phrase for a type of plant. [rule: none]
Run 2: 哪一个植物能不能吃：哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃，哪一个 and 能不能 create two overlapping question forms; use parallel clauses to state which plants are edible and which are not. [rule: none]
Run 3: 哪一个植物能不能吃：哪一种植物能吃，哪一种植物不能吃，哪一个 asks which single item, while 能不能 asks whether it can be eaten; use parallel clauses to explain both categories. [rule: none]

output.reason: All runs identify the mixed question forms in “哪一个植物能不能吃” and correctly replace them with parallel edible/non-edible clauses.
